theorems.name: Submission.bv_ext_infDist_compl_fderiv_lt
theorems.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (U : Set (Rn n)) (ξ : Rn n) (r : ℝ), IsOpen U → Convex ℝ U → Uᶜ.Nonempty → 0 < r → closedBall ξ r ⊆ U → ∃ η : ℝ, 0 < η ∧ ∀ x ∈ U, infDist x Uᶜ < η → DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y ↦ infDist y Uᶜ) x → r < -fderiv ℝ (fun y ↦ infDist y Uᶜ) x (x - ξ)
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
